description: Header file defining the wifiManager class for managing WiFi connections using NetworkManager on a GNOME environment, including methods for scanning, connecting, disconnecting, and configuring WiFi interfaces.

classes.name: wifiManager
classes.description: Singleton class providing WiFi management functionalities such as scanning, connecting, disconnecting, and configuring WiFi interfaces using NetworkManager.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of wifiManager.

methods.name: getWifiState
methods.description: Retrieves the current WiFi state.

methods.name: wifiDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the current WiFi connection.

methods.name: activateKnownConnection
methods.description: Activates a known WiFi connection by interface and optional connection ID.

methods.name: wifiConnectedSSIDInfo
methods.description: Gets information about the connected WiFi SSID.

methods.name: wifiConnect
methods.description: Connects to a WiFi network using provided SSID info.

methods.name: wifiScanRequest
methods.description: Requests a WiFi scan, optionally for a specific SSID.

methods.name: isWifiScannedRecently
methods.description: Checks if WiFi was scanned recently within a specified time limit.

methods.name: getKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of known SSIDs.

methods.name: addToKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Adds a WiFi network to the list of known SSIDs.

methods.name: removeKnownSSID
methods.description: Removes an SSID from the known list.

methods.name: quit
methods.description: Quits the WiFi manager with a specified NMDevice.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for a GMainLoop to complete with a timeout.

methods.name: startWPS
methods.description: Starts WPS process.

methods.name: stopWPS
methods.description: Stops WPS process.

methods.name: setInterfaceState
methods.description: Enables or disables a network interface.

methods.name: setIpSettings
methods.description: Sets IP configuration for a specified interface.

methods.name: setPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Sets the primary network interface.

methods.name: getWifiDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the WiFi device object.

methods.name: createClientNewConnection
methods.description: Creates a new client connection.

methods.name: deleteClientConnection
methods.description: Deletes the current client connection.

methods.name: wpsProcess
methods.description: Handles the WPS process.
